snip.t: Accumulated HIF-1α acts as a transcription factor that translocates to the nucleus and upregulates the expression of pro-angiogenic genes, most notably Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF)

qs.q: Tumor hypoxia stimulates the expression of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) through the stabilization and accumulation of which transcription factor?
qs.e: Under normal oxygen levels, HIF-1 alpha is degraded, but hypoxia stabilizes it so it can drive VEGF transcription and promote angiogenesis. NF-kappa B is primarily involved in inflammatory responses.
